nuggets.text: The Crusaders played the 1946 Orange Bowl against the other Miami, the Hurricanes, and lost 13-6 on a last-play interception return.
The Crusaders' first two games, against Lehigh and Colgate, ended with the exact same score: 35-10.
Wide receiver Ty Curran is the son of Crusaders head coach Dan Curran and transferred in from Ball State to play for his dad.
Crusaders coach Dan Curran led the Arena Football League in rushing in 2004 with the New Orleans VooDoo.
Before Holy Cross, Dan Curran coached Merrimack, whose 2021 team upset a ranked Crusaders squad.
Crusaders running back Joseph Williams was named to Bruce Feldman's Freaks List.
Myles Abernathy caught nine passes for 129 yards in his college debut, the Crusaders' first 100-yard receiving game since 2024.
Crusaders two-way star Gordie Lockbaum finished third in the 1987 Heisman Trophy voting, a year after placing fifth.
The Crusader Goodtime Marching Band has been performing Holy Cross halftime shows since 1910.
Saturday is the first meeting between the Crusaders and Miami (OH), their only FBS opponent this season.
